articles.summary: Discover the comprehensive range of Medicaid waiver programs available in Ohio designed to support older adults, people with disabilities, and youth with complex needs. Learn about eligibility requirements, services covered, and how these programs enable individuals to thrive in their own homes and communities. Dive into our friendly guide to find the right program for you or your loved one!
articles.title: What is the HCBS Waiver Program?

articles.summary: Supporting a family caregiver goes beyond offering help; it’s about providing the right kind of help. In this blog, we explore specific actions and words that offer genuine support to those who tirelessly care for their loved ones. Learn how to make a meaningful difference in a caregiver's life with practical tips on providing specific assistance, acknowledging their efforts, being a non-judgmental listener, and more. Show caregivers they’re not alone in their journey with authentic empathy and tangible support. Read on to find out how your actions can truly help.
articles.title: How to Support a Family Caregiver: The Words and Actions that Truly Help
